paragraphs: Intelligent Video Solutions supplies video software, together with hardware and installation, for training, education and research settings. Its platform, VALT, is a browser-based tool for clinical skills training and observation.

Faculty can lay out as many as sixteen cameras in a single view and steer those cameras from inside the software. Recordings can be started instantly from any view, scheduled to recur, or triggered by a button in the room. User permissions and encryption are described as supporting a program's HIPAA and FERPA compliance. The company sells it on a one-time perpetual license instead of an annual subscription.

Psychology and counseling programs use it to observe students in live or simulated sessions with real patients or in role-playing scenarios. A separate configuration is aimed at law enforcement and child advocacy interview recording. The company reports more than 50,000 active users across over 770 locations.
